description: This PHP source file defines the WorkScheduleService class responsible for managing employee work schedules within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It includes methods for retrieving and caching work schedule objects, handling class instantiation, and error management related to work schedule implementations.

classes.name: WorkScheduleService
classes.description: Service class responsible for retrieving, constructing, and caching employee work schedule objects, handling dynamic class instantiation, and integrating with Leave configuration.

methods.name: getWorkSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves the work schedule for a given employee number, creating and caching the schedule object if not already cached.
